# exo_federated_organization_identifier (Resource)

Manages the FederatedOrganizationIdentifier configuration via Set-FederatedOrganizationIdentifier.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `account_namespace` (String) Maps to the -AccountNamespace parameter.
- `default_domain` (String) Maps to the -DefaultDomain parameter.
- `delegation_federation_trust` (String) Maps to the -DelegationFederationTrust parameter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `organization_contact` (String) Maps to the -OrganizationContact parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
